title: Lazy Sunday Beans
description: A hearty and comforting dish made with tender broad beans, perfect for a relaxing Sunday afternoon.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the broad beans and stir to combine with the garlic and oil.
Season with stir fry and salt to taste.
Cook for 10-12 minutes, until the broad beans are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
Optional: serve with crusty bread or over rice.
